title.en: Gwaii Haanas · Shared care without a settled title
title.zh: 瓜伊哈纳斯 · 土地权属分歧中的共同守护

labelI18n.zh: 瓜伊哈纳斯，海达瓜依群岛南部

summary.en: On Lyell Island in 1985, a Haida blockade challenged logging, while the Haida Nation designated Gwaii Haanas a heritage site. The campaign linked forests and waters to the continuity of a people’s responsibilities. In 1993 the Haida Nation and Canada signed an agreement for shared management. Its opening pages placed two accounts of sovereignty and ownership beside each other instead of declaring one resolved. An equally represented board would guide planning and operation, while the agreement protected cultural activities and sustainable harvesting. This was practical government built around a shared commitment to care for a place despite fundamental disagreement. Reading the agreement alongside the blockade shows how community action could change institutions without reducing Haida history to the creation of a Canadian park.
summary.zh: 1985年，海达人在莱尔岛封锁伐木活动，海达民族同时将瓜伊哈纳斯列为遗产地。这场行动把森林、水域与族群持续承担的责任相联系。1993年，海达民族与加拿大签订共同管理协议。协议开篇并列双方对主权和所有权的不同解释，并未宣称分歧已经解决。双方人数相等的委员会负责规划与运作，协议也保护文化活动和可持续采集。这是在根本分歧仍存时，以共同照护一片土地为基础的治理实践。把协议与封锁行动并读，可见社区行动如何改变制度，而不能把海达历史缩减为一座加拿大公园的建立。

dateNote.en: 1985–1993 follows the heritage designation, blockade and agreement. It is not the beginning or end of Haida occupation or law.
dateNote.zh: 1985—1993年对应遗产地指定、封锁行动与协议，并非海达人居住或法律的起止。

title.en: c̓əsnaʔəm · Belongings, ancestors and a living village
title.zh: c̓əsnaʔəm · 物件、祖先与延续的村落

summary.en: For Musqueam people, c̓əsnaʔəm is an ancestral village and a continuing relationship, not a vanished culture beneath Vancouver. During the 1920s and 1930s, the institution that became the Museum of Vancouver removed belongings from the site for display. Its later exhibition acknowledged how those collections had helped tell a city history that excluded Musqueam. In 2012 community members maintained a vigil for more than 200 days to protect village and burial grounds threatened by development. Participant and curator Jordan Wilson describes keeping watch as a responsibility to ancestors and community. The collaborative exhibitions that followed brought oral histories, language and living people into the account. A stone or shell object thus asks two questions: how was it used, and who has the authority to explain its place in history?
summary.zh: 对穆斯奎姆人而言，c̓əsnaʔəm是祖先村落，也是一种持续的关系，并非埋在温哥华地下、已经消失的文化。1920至1930年代，后来成为温哥华博物馆的机构从遗址移走物件供展示。该馆后来的展览承认，这些收藏曾被用于书写排除穆斯奎姆人的城市史。2012年，社区成员持续守护两百余天，保护受开发威胁的村落与墓地。参与者兼策展人乔丹·威尔逊把守夜解释为对祖先及社区的责任。随后的合作展览将口述历史、语言与在世族人带入叙述。一件石器或贝器因此提出两个问题：它如何使用，又由谁说明它在历史中的位置？

dateNote.en: 1920 is a decade-level anchor for museum collecting; 2015 marks the collaborative exhibition period. These are documentation and protection dates, not the village’s cultural lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 1920年作为博物馆采集活动的十年期锚点，2015年对应合作展览时期；这是记录与保护活动的年代，并非村落文化的存续期限。

reviewLimit.zh: 物件与祖先遗骸不是同一类别。不使用遗骸图像；现代保护活动不意味着古代文化终止。

title.en: Fort Mose · Freedom made by households and a militia
title.zh: 莫塞堡 · 家庭与民兵建立的自由社区

location.label: Fort Mose, near St. Augustine, Florida

labelI18n.en: Fort Mose, near St. Augustine, Florida
labelI18n.zh: 莫塞堡，佛罗里达圣奥古斯丁附近

summary.en: People escaping enslavement in the British Carolinas crossed into Spanish Florida, where conversion to Catholicism and service to Spain offered a route to freedom. In 1738 the colonial governor established Fort Mose north of St. Augustine. Its free Black militia served a defensive purpose, but the settlement was also a community of women, men and children who farmed, fished and maintained households. Archaeologists recovered sewing tools, pottery, food remains and military equipment, bringing those everyday activities into view. War displaced the inhabitants, and the rebuilt settlement remained tied to Spain’s strategic needs. When Florida passed to Britain in 1763, the community moved to Cuba. Their achievement demonstrates both the agency of freedom seekers and the insecurity of liberty negotiated within rival slaveholding empires.
summary.zh: 逃离英属卡罗来纳奴役的人越境进入西属佛罗里达；皈依天主教并为西班牙服务，为他们提供了一条获得自由的道路。1738年，总督在圣奥古斯丁以北建立莫塞堡。自由黑人民兵承担防御任务，这里也住着耕作、捕鱼、维持家庭生活的男女老幼。考古发现的缝纫工具、陶器、食物遗存与军用品，使日常活动显现出来。战争曾迫使居民迁离，重建的聚落仍与西班牙的战略需要相连。1763年佛罗里达转归英国时，社区迁往古巴。这段历史既显示寻求自由者的行动能力，也显示在相互竞争、实行奴役的帝国内部协商自由的不稳定性。

dateNote.en: 1738–1763 covers the recognized free community in Spanish Florida, including displacement and rebuilding; it is not continuous occupation of one fort footprint.
dateNote.zh: 1738—1763年为西属佛罗里达获承认的自由社区时期，包含迁离与重建，不表示同一堡址从未间断的居住。

sources.publisher: Florida Museum of Natural History, University of Florida

sources.evidenceNoteZh: 1738年建立、家庭生活考古、农渔活动、战时迁离及1763年移居古巴。

reviewLimit.zh: 西班牙庇护附有条件，并与奴隶制度并存。博物馆与公园网页对重建年份有差异，正文不采用未经解决的精确年份。

title.en: Pullman, 1894 · A wage dispute becomes a railway boycott
title.zh: 1894年普尔曼 · 工资争议扩展为铁路抵制

summary.en: A railway-car company could shape both a worker’s pay packet and the place a family lived. When Pullman cut wages during the depression, workers challenged the company’s terms and struck in May 1894. Chicago’s city council appealed for public contributions to support their households. The dispute widened when the American Railway Union called on members to stop handling Pullman cars, disrupting traffic beyond the factory town. A federal injunction and the deployment of troops helped break the boycott; the workers won no immediate concessions. Solidarity also had boundaries: the union admitted white railway workers while excluding Black workers. The strike connects household survival, national transport networks and government power, while showing why a labour movement’s claim to represent workers must be examined alongside its membership rules.
summary.zh: 一家铁路客车公司既能影响工人的工资袋，也能决定其家庭居住的环境。经济萧条中普尔曼削减工资，工人反对公司条件，于1894年5月罢工。芝加哥市议会呼吁公众捐款支持罢工家庭。美国铁路工会随后号召会员拒绝挂运普尔曼车厢，使争议扩展到厂镇以外的交通网络。联邦禁令与派兵促成抵制失败，工人没有立即获得让步。团结也存在边界：该工会接纳白人铁路工人，却排斥黑人。这场罢工连接了家庭生计、全国运输网络与政府权力，也说明评估工会代表工人的主张时，须同时查看其会员规则。

dateNote.en: The entry follows the 1894 strike and boycott, not the full history of Pullman or later Black porter organizing.
dateNote.zh: 条目围绕1894年罢工与抵制，不是普尔曼全史或后来黑人列车服务员工会的历史。

title.en: Bracero contracts · Promises, work and remembered choices
title.zh: 布拉塞罗契约 · 承诺、劳动与回忆中的选择

location.label: Mexicali–Calexico border region, representative labour corridor

labelI18n.en: Mexicali–Calexico border region, representative labour corridor
labelI18n.zh: 墨西卡利—卡莱克西科边境，代表性劳工通道

summary.en: Between 1942 and 1964, agreements between Mexico and the United States brought Mexican workers north on temporary contracts. The paperwork promised protections for wages, housing and return transport; enforcement often fell short. Oral histories reveal decisions that an administrative total cannot explain. Ángel Guzmán Domínguez remembered friends gathering around a letter from the United States, then the uncertainty of recruitment and the lack of choice over assigned work. Other family testimony described debts and the effort to combine field labour with education. Labour archives preserve another perspective: organizers’ correspondence and campaigns over wages and the use of imported workers. Reading these sources together connects migration to household plans, employer power and collective action, without treating every contract as a different person or every worker’s experience as the same.
summary.zh: 1942至1964年，墨美两国协议使墨西哥劳工持短期契约赴美工作。文书承诺工资、住房与返乡交通方面的保护，执行却常有落差。口述历史揭示行政总数无法解释的选择。安赫尔·古斯曼·多明格斯回忆，朋友们围看一封来自美国的信，随后面对招募的不确定，以及无法自行选择所分配工作的处境。另一些家庭证词描述债务，以及兼顾田间劳动与求学的努力。劳工档案保存另一视角：组织者围绕工资和引入劳工问题的通信与行动。将这些材料并读，可把迁移与家庭计划、雇主权力和集体行动相连，同时避免把每份契约算作不同个人，或把所有劳工经验写成一样。

dateNote.en: 1942–1964 dates the bilateral programme, not all Mexican migration. The point represents a border region, not the interviewees’ verified itinerary.
dateNote.zh: 1942—1964年指双边计划，并非所有墨西哥移民的起止。地图点代表边境地区，不是受访者已核实的路线。

title.en: Codex Mendoza · Pictures passing through languages
title.zh: 《门多萨抄本》· 图像怎样跨越语言

summary.en: A painted book made in Mexico City in the 1540s brought several kinds of knowledge onto the same page. Nahua painter-scribes depicted rulers, tribute and the upbringing and occupations of boys and girls. Spoken explanations in Nahuatl then passed through an interpreter into Spanish, and a scribe added commentary and labels. The Codex Mendoza therefore preserves much more than pictures of an earlier society: it records an encounter between systems of writing and explanation under colonial rule. A list of feathers, skins or cacao can describe an imperial obligation; a Spanish label can also reshape a Nahua concept. Reading image and commentary together lets us ask both what the makers wanted to communicate and what changed when their knowledge addressed European readers.
summary.zh: 16世纪40年代，墨西哥城制作的一部彩绘书，把几种知识形式汇集在同一页上。纳瓦画师兼书写者描绘统治者、贡赋，以及男女儿童的成长和各种职业。纳瓦特尔语口述解释经过译者转为西班牙语，抄写者再补入长篇说明与标注。因此，《门多萨抄本》不仅保存了征服前社会的图像，也记录了殖民统治下不同书写和解释体系的相遇。羽毛、兽皮或可可的清单能够表现帝国贡赋义务；一个西班牙语标签也可能改变纳瓦概念的含义。把图像与说明并读，可以追问制作者希望传达什么，以及知识面向欧洲读者时发生了怎样的变化。

dateNote.en: The 1540s are an approximate production interval; publications often give about 1541–1542. The earlier events depicted in the book are not its production dates.
dateNote.zh: 16世纪40年代是约略制作时段；出版物常标为约1541—1542年。书中所描绘的早期事件不是抄本的制作年代。

title.en: Q’eswachaka · A bridge rebuilt through shared knowledge
title.zh: 克斯瓦恰卡 · 共同知识重建的桥梁

summary.en: A bridge across the Apurímac River depends on more than strong rope. The Quechua communities of Huinchiri, Chaupibanda, Choccayhua and Ccollana Quehue renew Q’eswachaka through coordinated work, specialist building knowledge and ritual obligations. Grasses become braided cords and heavy cables; builders bring these separate contributions into a crossing. In 2013 the knowledge, skills and rituals of renewal received UNESCO recognition. Two years later, community specialists rebuilt a version on Washington’s National Mall. Rope makers and bridge builders demonstrated the process, and Afro-Peruvian musicians helped raise the heavy ropes. The encounter makes continuity visible as skilled work performed again, shared between generations and explained to new audiences. Preserving the bridge therefore means sustaining the people and relationships that can build it.
summary.zh: 横跨阿普里马克河的一座桥，依靠的不只是结实绳索。温奇里、乔皮班达、乔卡伊瓦和科利亚纳凯韦四个克丘亚社区，以协作劳动、专业营造知识和仪式责任更新克斯瓦恰卡桥。草被搓成细绳，再编成粗缆，造桥者将各方贡献组合成可通行的桥梁。2013年，重建所需的知识、技能和仪式获联合国教科文组织列名。两年后，社区工匠在华盛顿国家广场建造了一座展示桥。制绳者和造桥者演示工序，非裔秘鲁音乐家也参与抬起沉重的绳缆。这次相遇说明，延续来自反复实践的技艺、代际传授，以及向新观众解释的能力。保存这座桥，也就是维系能够重建它的人与关系。

dateNote.en: 2013–2015 follows heritage recognition and a documented demonstration abroad. It does not date the origin or end of the continuing renewal tradition.
dateNote.zh: 2013—2015年对应遗产列名与有记录的海外展示，并非仍在延续的重建传统之起止。

sources.title: El Q’eswachaka de Canas: Ingeniería y tradición en las comunidades de Quehue
sources.evidenceNote: Printed pp. 9–11 identify the four communities, Apurímac setting, collective renewal and UNESCO recognition four years after 2009. Exact ancient origin claims are not adopted.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 印刷页9—11载四社区、阿普里马克河背景、集体重建，以及2009年四年后的联合国教科文组织列名；未采用精确古代起源说法。

sources.title: 50 Objects — Q’eswachaka Rope Bridge
sources.publisher: Smithsonian Center for Folklife and Cultural Heritage

reviewLimit.en: The modern renewal provides a specific living-community connection to Andean infrastructure; it does not establish an unchanged technique or identical social organization across all centuries.
reviewLimit.zh: 现代重建为安第斯基础设施提供了具体的活态社区联系，并不证明历代技术和社会组织始终相同。

title.en: Tula’s Curaçao revolt · Freedom argued across an ocean
title.zh: 图拉的库拉索起义 · 跨海传来的自由论辩

summary.en: On 17 August 1795, enslaved workers at Knip plantation in western Curaçao refused to work. Tula helped turn that refusal into a wider movement demanding freedom. At Porto Mari, the priest Jacobus Schinck met him on behalf of the colonial authorities. Schinck’s report preserved an argument that connected local bondage to Atlantic politics: if enslaved people under French rule had gained freedom and France now dominated the Netherlands, why should slavery continue here? The colonial government suppressed the revolt and executed Tula on 3 October. His reasoning survives through an intermediary’s account, alongside official records written to prosecute the rebels. Those unequal archives reveal people following international change and making claims of their own, even as their lives before the uprising remain poorly documented.
summary.zh: 1795年8月17日，库拉索西部克尼普种植园的被奴役者拒绝劳动。图拉协助把拒工发展为要求自由的更大运动。在波尔托马里，神父雅各布斯·申克代表殖民当局与他会面。申克的报告保留了一段将本地奴役与大西洋政治相连的论辩：既然法国统治下的被奴役者已获自由，而法国又控制了荷兰，为何这里仍维持奴隶制？殖民政府镇压起义，并于10月3日处死图拉。他的论述经由中间人的记录留存，与用于起诉起义者的官方文书并置。这些不对等的档案显示，被奴役者也在关注国际变化并提出自身诉求；但他们起义前的生活仍缺乏记录。

dateNote.en: 1795 is the year of the revolt, from the August refusal to Tula’s October execution. It is not a lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 1795年对应起义，从8月拒工至图拉10月被处死，并非生卒年。

sources.title: Eerherstel voor vrijheidsstrijder Tula
sources.evidenceNote: 17 August 1795 Knip refusal, Schinck’s mediated report, 3 October execution and the limits of colonial documentation. Unsupported birthplaces and exact rebel totals are omitted.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 1795年8月17日克尼普拒工、申克转述报告、10月3日处决及殖民档案局限；未采用无据出生地或精确起义人数。

sources.title: Educatiemappen — Tula and the 1795 uprising
sources.evidenceNote: Island archive discusses the Porto Mari meeting, Tula’s argument concerning French emancipation and Dutch rule, and his execution. Reported speech is paraphrased as reported, not presented as a transcript in his own hand.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 岛上档案馆叙述波尔托马里会面、法国解放奴隶与荷兰统治之间的论辩及处决；以转述方式概括发言，不当作图拉亲笔逐字稿。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: Tula’s words reach us through Schinck and colonial records. The account does not infer a precise birthplace, age or complete political programme.
reviewLimit.zh: 图拉的言论通过申克和殖民文书传至今天；本条不推断精确出生地、年龄或完整政治纲领。

title.en: Cordel · A market for poems and public argument
title.zh: 科尔德尔文学 · 集市中的诗歌与公共论辩

labelI18n.zh: 累西腓，巴西东北部文化背景

summary.en: A small printed booklet could also be a performance. In northeastern Brazilian markets, cordel poets recited stories to listeners while selling their texts. News, politics, moral dilemmas and heroes entered verse, accompanied by covers made with woodcuts, photographs or other images. The Library of Congress collection preserves booklets dating from 1930 onward, together with recordings made around 1968–1970; it allows readers to compare a printed object with an audible voice. These holdings document parts of a much longer and continuing tradition. In 2018, Brazil recognized literatura de cordel as cultural heritage after a request supported by poets. Its movement from stalls into collections and online circulation shows popular writing changing its means of reaching people while retaining the exchange between storyteller and audience.
summary.zh: 一本薄薄的印刷小册子，也可以是一场表演。在巴西东北部的集市，科尔德尔诗人一边向听众朗诵故事，一边售卖文本。新闻、政治、道德难题与英雄事迹进入诗句，封面则可采用木刻、照片等图像。美国国会图书馆的收藏保存了1930年以来的小册子，以及约1968—1970年的录音，使读者能够把印刷物与声音并读。这些馆藏只是更久远且仍在延续的传统中的一部分。2018年，在诗人支持的申请之后，巴西将科尔德尔文学列为文化遗产。从摊位进入馆藏，再通过互联网传播，民间写作不断改变接触公众的方式，同时延续讲述者与听众之间的交流。

dateNote.en: 1930 marks the earliest dated material in the cited collection; 2018 marks national heritage recognition. Neither is an origin or endpoint for cordel.
dateNote.zh: 1930年是所引馆藏的最早材料年代，2018年是国家遗产列名年份；两者均非科尔德尔文学的起源或终点。

sources.title: Brazilian Chapbooks — Folklife and Creative Writing
sources.publisher: Library of Congress, American Folklife Center
sources.evidenceNote: Market recitation, subjects and cover media; collection from 1930; Sol Biderman recordings circa 1968–1970; online circulation. No collection count is frozen into the narrative.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 集市朗诵、题材、封面媒介、1930年起的馆藏、索尔·比德曼约1968—1970年录音和网络传播；未将会变化的藏品数量写入正文。

sources.title: Registro da Literatura de Cordel como Patrimônio Cultural do Brasil
sources.evidenceNote: The registration account dates the council’s approval to 19 September 2018 and identifies the poets’ supporting request, research and safeguarding process.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 登记行动说明将理事会批准时间定为2018年9月19日，并载诗人支持申请、研究及保护程序。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: Recife is a regional reading anchor, not the provenance of every booklet. Modern works and photographs retain their own copyright.
reviewLimit.zh: 累西腓是区域阅读锚点，并非每本小册子的来源地；现代作品与照片各自保有版权。

title.en: Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo · How a search became collective
title.zh: 五月广场母亲 · 寻人怎样成为集体行动

labelI18n.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯五月广场

summary.en: On 30 April 1977, mothers searching for their disappeared children gathered in Buenos Aires’s Plaza de Mayo. Police orders to keep moving helped give their protest its circling form. Behind that visible action lay quieter work: sharing information, maintaining contact and deciding who could speak for a group. An October instruction sheet preserved by Memoria Abierta records a meeting disguised as a retirement farewell in a park. Flowers and speeches concealed discussions about local groups and delegates; the written instructions omitted contact details because the participants knew they were watched. Three founding mothers were themselves abducted and disappeared that December. Their first year connects the public courage of a march with the practical and dangerous labour of building a movement under dictatorship.
summary.zh: 1977年4月30日，寻找失踪子女的母亲们来到布宜诺斯艾利斯五月广场。警察要求她们保持移动，使抗议逐渐形成绕圈行走的方式。可见的行动背后，还有较少被看见的工作：交换信息、维持联络，以及决定谁能代表一个小组发言。开放记忆档案保存的一份10月指示，记录了在公园中假装举行退休欢送会的集会。鲜花与致辞掩护着有关地区小组和代表的讨论；参与者知道自己受到监视，因此书面指示省去了联络资料。当年12月，三位创始母亲也遭绑架并被迫失踪。这一年的经历，把公开游行的勇气与独裁统治下建立组织所需的具体而危险的劳动联系起来。

dateNote.en: The focus is the movement’s first year, 1977; its work did not end then.
dateNote.zh: 本条聚焦运动的第一年1977年；其行动并未在当年结束。

sources.title: 44 años de la primera ronda de Madres de Plaza de Mayo
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the first Plaza de Mayo gathering to 30 April 1977 and explains the police instruction to circulate.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 将首次五月广场集会定于1977年4月30日，并解释警察要求继续走动。

sources.title: Memorias de la memoria — Madres de Plaza de Mayo
sources.evidenceNote: Archive introduction and October 1977 instruction description support information-sharing, disguised park meeting, local delegates, omitted contact details and December disappearances of three founders. Their separate abduction sites are not conflated.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 档案导言和1977年10月指示说明支持信息交换、伪装公园集会、地区代表、省略联络资料，以及12月三位创始成员被迫失踪；未混同其不同被绑架地点。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: The first-year story does not treat the later organizations and their positions as a single unchanging body.
reviewLimit.zh: 第一年的故事不把后来各组织及其立场视为始终一致的整体。

title.en: A Palauan bai · Builders behind a museum house
title.zh: 帕劳会所 · 博物馆建筑背后的建造者

labelI18n.zh: 帕劳科罗尔，来源社区背景

summary.en: A meeting house in Berlin carries the work of Palauan builders across several generations. In 1907, master builder Golegeril and members of the Ngaradegangl men’s club built a reduced-scale bai in Koror for the ethnologist Augustin Krämer. First displayed in 1908, it later acquired a museum-made floor and roof framework. In 2022, Patrick Tellei’s team from Palau began reroofing it with palm-leaf shingles prepared at home. The building’s history sits within a larger political story: village bai hosted chiefly councils and men’s clubs that organized public work, while colonial intervention weakened those institutions. Belau National Museum places bai alongside childbirth, taro cultivation, fishing and funerals in its account of the life cycle. Looking at the house through these connections restores its makers and social purposes to view.
summary.zh: 柏林的一座会所保存着几代帕劳建造者的劳动。1907年，营造师戈莱盖里尔与恩加拉德冈尔男子社团成员，在科罗尔为民族学者奥古斯丁·克雷默建造了缩小比例的拜会所。它于1908年首次展出，后来又添入博物馆制作的地板和屋顶框架。2022年，帕特里克·泰莱率帕劳团队，开始以在本国制作的棕榈叶屋面重铺屋顶。建筑背后还有政治史：村落会所容纳首领议事会，以及组织公共工程的男子社团，殖民干预则削弱了这些机构。贝劳国家博物馆在生命历程展示中，把会所与生育、种芋、捕鱼和葬礼并列。沿着这些联系阅读建筑，能够重新看见其制作者与社会用途。

dateNote.en: 1907–2022 follows this commissioned museum building and its later roof work, not the origin or endpoint of Palauan meeting-house traditions.
dateNote.zh: 1907—2022年对应这座受委托制作的馆藏建筑及后来的屋顶工程，并非帕劳会所传统的起止。

sources.title: Humboldt Forum: Reroofing the Meeting House and Assembling a Double-Hulled Canoe
sources.evidenceNote: 1907 maker and club, reduced scale, 1908 display, later museum additions and 2022 roof work; political roles and colonial disruption.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 1907年制作者与社团、缩小比例、1908年展出、博物馆后来增建、2022年屋顶工程，以及政治用途和殖民干预。

sources.title: Exhibits — Cycle of Life
sources.evidenceNote: The Palauan museum explains its life-cycle display through childbirth, taro, fishing, bai and funerals, connected by the kitchen and family/clan relationships. Only this directly relevant section is used.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 帕劳博物馆以生育、芋田、捕鱼、会所与葬礼解释生命历程展示，并联系厨房与家族、氏族关系；仅使用直接相关段落。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: A commissioned reduced-scale museum house is distinguished from an unaltered village building. Its history cannot stand for every bai or all Palauan political institutions.
reviewLimit.zh: 受委托制作的缩小比例馆藏会所不同于未经改建的村落建筑；它的历史不能代表每座会所或帕劳全部政治机构。

title.en: Vanuatu sand drawing · Knowledge moving with a finger
title.zh: 瓦努阿图沙画 · 随手指移动的知识

location.label: Northern Ambrym, one documented sand-drawing setting

labelI18n.en: Northern Ambrym, one documented sand-drawing setting
labelI18n.zh: 安布里姆岛北部，一处有记录的沙画背景

summary.en: A line traced in sand can carry a story, a procedure and knowledge of a place. Research on northern Ambrym, published in 2021, examined sand drawing alongside string-figure making. Both practices were described with a local verb meaning “to write”; their sequences, repetitions and symmetry offered ways to connect cultural knowledge with mathematics teaching. This is one island setting within a diverse tradition. In 2025, the Vanuatu Kaljoral Senta and New Mexico’s Museum of International Folk Art announced a collaborative exhibition featuring Edgar Hinge, a practitioner from Pentecost. The project connected stories, genealogies and histories with discussion of museum collections and possible returns. Such work asks viewers to follow the knowledge and relationships involved in making a drawing, as well as the pattern left on the ground.
summary.zh: 在沙上划出的一条线，可以承载故事、操作步骤与关于地方的知识。2021年发表的一项安布里姆岛北部研究，将沙画与翻绳并读。当地以一个意为“书写”的动词描述两种实践；其中的步骤、重复和对称，为文化知识与数学教学建立联系。这只是多样传统中的一个岛屿场景。2025年，瓦努阿图文化中心与新墨西哥州国际民间艺术博物馆宣布合作展览，由来自彭特科斯特岛的实践者埃德加·欣奇参与。项目把故事、谱系与历史的表达，同馆藏及可能归还的讨论联系起来。观看沙画时，值得追随的不只是地面留下的图案，还有创作所涉及的知识与人际关系。

dateNote.en: 2021–2025 identifies the research publication and exhibition announcement discussed here. It does not date the beginning or ending of sand drawing.
dateNote.zh: 2021—2025年对应本条讨论的研究发表与展览公告，并非沙画传统的起止年代。

sources.title: Sand Drawing versus String Figure Making: Geometric and Algorithmic Practices in Northern Ambrym, Vanuatu
sources.publisher: Eric Vandendriessche / National University of Vanuatu research portal
sources.evidenceNote: Author’s published research abstract identifies northern Ambrym, the verb tu, linked cultural meanings, geometric procedures and a classroom experiment. Citation metadata dates the chapter to 2021.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 作者的已发表研究摘要说明安布里姆岛北部、动词tu、文化含义、几何步骤及课堂实验；书目数据标为2021年。

sources.title: Museum of International Folk Art announces Sandroing: Tracing Kastom in Vanuatu
sources.publisher: New Mexico Department of Cultural Affairs / MOIFA
sources.evidenceNote: April 2025 announcement establishes collaboration with VKS, Pentecost practitioner Edgar Hinge, knowledge and historical storytelling, and discussion of potential repatriation. Narrative reports the announcement, not a completed return.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 2025年4月公告载与瓦努阿图文化中心合作、彭特科斯特实践者埃德加·欣奇、知识及历史讲述，并讨论可能归还；正文叙述公告，不声称归还已完成。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: Northern Ambrym and Pentecost are identified separately. The story does not make every drawing public knowledge or infer a completed repatriation from exhibition plans.
reviewLimit.zh: 安布里姆岛北部与彭特科斯特岛分别注明；不把所有图案当作可公开知识，也不由展览计划推断归还已经完成。

title.en: Torres Strait 1936 · Owning a boat, controlling its work
title.zh: 1936年托雷斯海峡 · 船归谁，劳动由谁掌握

location.label: Badu, one centre of the multi-island strike

labelI18n.en: Badu, one centre of the multi-island strike
labelI18n.zh: 巴杜岛，多岛罢工的一处中心

summary.en: In January 1936, Torres Strait Islander crews refused recruitment to boats they owned but could not freely control. Queensland’s Protectors directed crewing and restricted access to earnings. The dispute therefore reached beyond a wage rate into travel, local councils and the ability to manage community affairs. Badu participant Nau Mabaig later recalled strike messages moving between islands aboard a cargo boat: a vessel serving the official trading system also carried resistance. Participation and returns to work differed between islands; Mer, Saibai and Boigu continued after some others had resumed. In September, changes included access to boat accounts and a greater role for elected councillors in recruitment. The episode joins maritime knowledge and labour organization to a continuing demand for authority over everyday life.
summary.zh: 1936年1月，托雷斯海峡岛民船员拒绝受招登上属于自己、却无法自由支配的船只。昆士兰的“保护官”决定船员招募，并限制人们领取收入。因此，争议超出工资高低，涉及岛际往来、地方议事会，以及管理社区事务的能力。巴杜岛参与者瑙·马拜格后来回忆，罢工消息由一艘货船传往各岛：服务于官方贸易体系的船，也传递着抵抗。不同岛屿的参与和复工时间并不相同；一些岛屿复工后，梅尔、赛拜和博伊古仍然坚持。9月的改变包括向船员提供船只账目，以及扩大民选议员在招募中的作用。这段历史把海上知识与劳动组织，同掌握日常生活决定权的持续诉求联系起来。

dateNote.en: 1936 is the strike year. It was a multi-island process with differing participation and settlement dates, not one uniform stoppage everywhere.
dateNote.zh: 1936年为罢工年份；这是参与和结束时间各不相同的多岛过程，并非各地完全同步的一次停工。

sources.title: 1936 Torres Strait Islands Maritime Strike
sources.publisher: Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies
sources.evidenceNote: Company-boat control, January refusal, Nau Mabaig’s retrospective account, differing island responses and September administrative changes are documented with archival references.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 附档案注释说明公司船控制、1月拒工、瑙·马拜格事后口述、各岛不同回应及9月管理改变。

sources.title: 1900–1945: Reform, protest and war — 1936 Maritime Strike
sources.evidenceNote: Corroborates 1936 and the combination of working-condition and self-determination demands. Its broad nine-month description and ambiguous voting-rights formulation are not extended into stronger claims.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 佐证1936年及劳动条件与自主权两类诉求；未把其笼统九个月说法及含混投票权措辞扩展为更强断言。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: Reported memories and official records offer different viewpoints. Badu’s map pin represents one centre, not the whole strike or a reconstructed route.
reviewLimit.zh: 事后记忆与官方文书提供不同视角；巴杜地图点代表一处中心，不是整个罢工范围或复原路线。

title.en: Possum-skin cloaks · Making a living inheritance
title.zh: 袋貂皮披风 · 制作仍在延续的传承

labelI18n.zh: 墨尔本，馆藏接触与展览背景

summary.en: In 1999, Aboriginal artists Vicki Couzens, Treahna Hamm and Lee Darroch examined nineteenth-century possum-skin cloaks from Lake Condah and Maiden’s Punt near Echuca in Museum Victoria. Research and making led to new cloaks and related artworks, acquired by the National Museum of Australia in 2003. Exhibitions in 2005–2006 presented the artists’ own accounts of production and community meaning. Couzens, a Keerray Woorroong Gunditjmara artist, describes cloak workshops as occasions for generations to share stories, language, responsibilities and relationships to Country. Relearning how to prepare and join skins can open further questions about ceremony and belonging. This renewal grew through named makers and communities in southeastern Australia; it makes cultural continuity visible as work, teaching and creative decisions carried into the present.
summary.zh: 1999年，原住民艺术家维姬·库曾斯、特里阿娜·哈姆和李·达罗赫，在维多利亚博物馆查看了来自康达湖与埃丘卡附近梅登渡口的19世纪袋貂皮披风。研究与制作带来了新披风及相关艺术品，澳大利亚国家博物馆于2003年收藏了这些作品。2005—2006年的展览呈现艺术家自己讲述的制作过程与社区意义。基里·武龙—贡第杰马拉艺术家库曾斯认为，披风工作坊让不同世代分享故事、语言、责任及与传统土地的关系。重新学习如何处理和缝合皮料，还会引出关于仪式与归属的进一步问题。这场复兴由澳大利亚东南部具名制作者与社区推动，使文化延续显现为延续至今的劳动、教学和创作选择。

dateNote.en: 1999–2006 follows the documented renewal project, collection and exhibitions. The objects studied were older, and community practice continues beyond this interval.
dateNote.zh: 1999—2006年对应有记录的复兴项目、收藏与展览；所研究物件更古老，社区实践也延续至这一时段之后。

sources.title: “We have survived” — Reclaiming possum skin cloaks (1999–2006)
sources.evidenceNote: Section on cloak reclamation identifies the 1999 visit, named artists, source cloaks, 2003 acquisition and 2005–2006 exhibitions with artist consultation and accounts.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 披风复兴一节载1999年查看、具名艺术家、来源披风、2003年入藏及2005—2006年由艺术家参与解释的展览。

sources.title: Possum skin cloaks then and now
sources.evidenceNote: First-person account identifies Couzens’s community and explains intergenerational workshops, language, responsibilities, Country and continuing use. Modern artwork is attributed to its maker.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 第一人称叙述注明库曾斯的社区背景，并解释跨代工作坊、语言、责任、传统土地关系及延续用途；现代作品归于具名制作者。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: The specific southeastern renewal is not presented as one uniform tradition across Aboriginal Australia. New cloaks are contemporary works with living makers and rights.
reviewLimit.zh: 这场具体的东南部复兴不被视为澳大利亚全体原住民的统一传统；新披风是由当代制作者创作并享有权利的作品。

title.en: Pūnana Leo · Families make a place for Hawaiian
title.zh: 普纳纳莱奥 · 家庭为夏威夷语创造空间

location.label: Kekaha, Kauaʻi, first Pūnana Leo preschool

labelI18n.en: Kekaha, Kauaʻi, first Pūnana Leo preschool
labelI18n.zh: 考艾岛凯卡哈，首所普纳纳莱奥幼儿园

summary.en: Hawaiian-language educators who met in 1983 asked how children could grow up using the language in ordinary life. Their answer joined family commitment to new institutions. The first Pūnana Leo preschool opened at Kekaha on Kauaʻi in 1984, followed by schools in Hilo and Honolulu. The name, often rendered “nest of voices,” acknowledged the inspiration of Māori kōhanga reo. Advocates worked to remove legal obstacles to Hawaiian-medium education in 1986; public elementary immersion classes followed in 1987. A later study written by participating families describes parents learning and using Hawaiian at home, then becoming teachers and grandparents in the movement. Revitalization emerges through those repeated daily choices: who speaks to a child, what language carries a lesson, and how a family’s effort becomes shared public provision.
summary.zh: 1983年相聚的夏威夷语教育者，思考怎样让儿童在日常生活中使用这种语言成长。他们的回答，把家庭投入与新机构结合起来。首所普纳纳莱奥幼儿园于1984年在考艾岛凯卡哈开办，随后希洛与檀香山也设立学校。常译为“声音之巢”的名称，表达了毛利语“语言巢”给予的启发。倡议者推动于1986年排除夏威夷语教学的法律障碍，公立小学沉浸式班级于1987年开办。参与家庭后来合写的研究，叙述父母怎样在家学习并使用夏威夷语，继而成为运动中的教师和祖父母。语言复兴体现于反复进行的日常选择：谁与孩子交谈，课堂使用什么语言，以及一个家庭的努力如何转变为共同的公共教育。

dateNote.en: 1983–1987 follows organization, preschool opening, legal change and initial public classes. It is not the full history of Hawaiian-language education.
dateNote.zh: 1983—1987年对应组织成立、幼儿园开办、法律改变与最初公立班级，并非夏威夷语教育的全部历史。

sources.title: Our History
sources.evidenceNote: Community organization records 1983 formation, August 1984 Kekaha opening, Māori inspiration, 1986 advocacy and 1987 public classes. The claim concerns medium of instruction, not a universal ban on speaking Hawaiian.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 社区组织记录1983年成立、1984年8月凯卡哈开办、毛利语运动启发、1986年倡议及1987年公立班级；相关说法针对教学语言，不是全面禁止讲夏威夷语。

sources.title: Pūʻā i ka ʻŌlelo, Ola ka ʻOhana: Three Generations of Hawaiian Language Revitalization
sources.publisher: Keiki K. C. Kawaiʻaeʻa and coauthors, Hūlili 4(1), 2007 / University of Hawaiʻi at Hilo
sources.evidenceNote: Printed pp.183–187 contain participant-family perspectives, chronology and home-to-school generational transmission; 1987 Waiau and Keaukaha teaching are identified.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 印刷页183—187载参与家庭视角、年表及家庭到学校的代际传承，注明1987年瓦伊奥与凯奥卡哈教学。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: The schools’ history is told alongside participating families; present-day programme counts and “first in the world” claims are not required.
reviewLimit.zh: 学校历史与参与家庭并读；本条无需现今项目数量或“世界第一”等断言。

title.en: Pulemelei · A monument within a lived landscape
title.zh: 普莱梅莱 · 生活景观中的纪念建筑

labelI18n.zh: 萨摩亚萨瓦伊岛帕劳利

summary.en: Pulemelei’s stone mass rises within an older settlement landscape on Savaiʻi. Archaeologists place its first platform broadly in the early second millennium CE, with different analyses yielding overlapping ranges rather than a single construction year. Surrounding remains include platforms, ovens, walls and paved paths; the monument was part of people’s movement and work, not an isolated object. Its height and position overlooking approaches from the sea invite questions about authority and the organization of labour. Excavation and geophysical study also indicate more than one building stage. Samoan scholar and chief Tui Atua Tupua Tamasese Efi described the 2003 ceremonies connected with research as a renewed engagement with ancestors and sacred obligations. Archaeological layers and this community account illuminate different dimensions of the same place without making one substitute for the other.
summary.zh: 萨瓦伊岛的普莱梅莱石台，耸立在一片更早的聚落景观中。考古学者将最初平台大致置于公元第二个千年的早期；不同分析给出相互重叠的时段，而非某个精确建造年。周围遗迹包括平台、地炉、墙垣和铺砌道路，说明纪念建筑处于人们行走与劳动的空间之中。它的高度，以及能够俯瞰海上来路的位置，引出关于权威与劳动组织的问题。发掘和地球物理调查也显示不止一个营造阶段。萨摩亚学者与首领图伊·阿图阿·图普阿·塔马塞塞·埃菲，把2003年研究期间举行的仪式描述为重新联系祖先和神圣责任的过程。考古层位与这份社区叙述照亮同一地方的不同面向，彼此不能替代。

dateNote.en: 1000–1400 is a broad estimate for the initial construction phase, not continuous construction or a cultural lifespan. Published estimates also include 1050–1250 and approximately 1100–1300. The 2003 ceremony is modern evidence of the place’s continuing significance.
dateNote.zh: 1000—1400年是初期营造阶段的宽幅估计，并非持续施工或文化存续期。已发表估计还包括1050—1250年及约1100—1300年。2003年仪式是该地意义延续至现代的证据。

sources.title: Archaeological Investigations in Independent Samoa, in Monuments and People in the Pacific
sources.publisher: Helene Martinsson-Wallin / Uppsala University, 2014, author-posted text
sources.evidenceNote: Printed pp.252–255 describe the initial platform, older occupation, surrounding settlement features and the interpretation of its elevated seaward position; burial and Tongan-origin hypotheses remain unresolved.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 印刷页252—255描述最初平台、较早居住、周边聚落遗迹及临海高地位置的解释；埋葬与汤加起源假说仍未确定。

sources.title: Early architecture in Tonga: implications for the development of Polynesian chiefdoms
sources.publisher: Geoffrey Clark, Phillip Parton and Christian Reepmeyer / Antiquity, 2024
sources.evidenceNote: Comparative discussion explicitly records alternative Pulemelei first-phase ranges of 1000–1400 and 1050–1250. The atlas uses the broad window, not a false precise date.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 比较讨论明确记录普莱梅莱初期的1000—1400年与1050—1250年不同估计；地图使用宽幅时窗，不制造精确日期。

sources.title: In search of Tagaloa: Pulemelei, Samoan Mythology and Science, in Archaeology in Samoa
sources.publisher: Tui Atua Tupua Tamasese Taisi Tupuola Tufuga Efi / Archaeology in Oceania 42 supplement, 2007, author-posted volume
sources.evidenceNote: Printed pp.5–10 give the Samoan participant’s account of 2003 ceremonies, ancestry and obligations. The volume’s geophysical study records at least two platform-building events. Spiritual interpretation is attributed, not used as archaeological proof of a grave or migration.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 印刷页5—10为萨摩亚参与者对2003年仪式、祖先与责任的叙述；同卷地球物理研究记录至少两次平台营造。精神性解释明确归于叙述者，不用来证明墓葬或迁徙。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis of inspected community, institutional and archival sources; source-specific coverage is recorded below.

reviewLimit.en: Scale and location support questions about social organization; they do not by themselves identify a named ruler, prove a royal tomb or establish a direct Tongan voyage.
reviewLimit.zh: 规模与位置支持对社会组织的提问，但本身不能识别具名统治者、证明王陵，或确立一次直接汤加航行。
